title: Venture into Space: Early Years of Goddard Space Flight Center
lineage: NASA institutional history, inspected p. 22; saved file is a research note.

passages.note: NASA institutional history, page 22, says the Quito tracking station was unable to detect Vanguard I at the close of 1964, after more than six years of solar-powered signals. This is a tracking observation, not proof of the transmitter failure date.
